summary: Verified MAP → BUSINESS → DRIVER-configurator routing bug fix. All 3 requested scenarios pass on live preview using bearer disp-test-token-777. (1) MAIN: /map radius-50 + cat-driver → tap Ale Bragato (map-business-user_5ca043918cc5) → URL becomes /provider/user_5ca043918cc5?cat=driver → CTA reads t('requestService') ('Request service', NOT 'View products & order' i.e. NOT t('viewAndOrder')) → tap prov-request navigates to /driver/configura?provider=user_5ca043918cc5&providerName=Ale%20Bragato and the 7-step DRIVER wizard renders (step 1: NCC vs Taxi). Products section is correctly hidden. (2) REGRESSION provider person: /provider/prov_cfbd9805ce97?cat=driver (Giulia, multi-service) → CTA 'Request service', prov-request → /driver/configura (standard-intent wins over picker). (3) REGRESSION business w/o filter: (a) direct /provider/user_5ca043918cc5 and (b) map cat-all → Ale both show 'View products & order' CTA + Products section, tap routes to /business-request/user_5ca043918cc5 (free-text form since Ale has no catalog). Also confirmed map now correctly omits ?cat= when 'Tutte le categorie' is active. Note on locale: browser default lang is EN so labels are 'Request service' / 'View products & order' which are the exact i18n translations of the Italian labels quoted in the request ('Richiedi servizio' / 'Vedi prodotti e ordina') — this is functionally identical (same t() keys) and not a bug.

rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent, confirmed by code review + UI test): (1) map.tsx passed ?cat=${category} only for providers, not for businesses, so tapping Ale from the driver-filtered map lost the intent. (2) provider/[id].tsx used `isBusiness ? businessOrder : configurator` without considering the map's standard-service intent, so any business went to the free-text order form even when the map filter clearly requested a standard service like Driver. Fix: (a) map.tsx now appends ?cat= to both provider AND business cards; (b) provider/[id].tsx computes standardIntent = preCat is a configurable service offered by the profile, then routes to CFG_ROUTE[cat] first (works for both provider and business), falling back to product-order only when isBusiness && !standardIntent. CTA label and Products section are also driven by showOrder=isBusiness && !standardIntent.
